description: This file defines a class `MacroNode` in the Twig templating engine, representing a macro node within the Twig syntax tree. It contains logic for constructing, validating, and compiling a macro node, including handling macro arguments and generating corresponding PHP code.

classes.name: MacroNode
classes.description: Represents a macro node within the Twig syntax tree, capable of compiling itself into PHP code for rendering Twig macros.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for MacroNode, initializes the macro with its name, body, arguments, and line number. Validates argument types and throws errors if reserved variable names are used.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the macro node into PHP code using the provided Compiler object, generating a PHP method to render the macro.
